name: lium
description: Rent GPUs from Lium — the decentralized compute marketplace of Bittensor subnet 51. Providers list nodes, validators score them and set weights on-chain, renters take pods by the hour. The whole surface is one MCP tool layer (Streamable HTTP at /mcp plus stdio) served by a Rust backend that speaks the live Lium platform API, so an agent can browse the market, rent a node, read its pod's logs and stop it again without a human in the loop. The console adds a marketplace browser, a pods panel, a subnet-51 view (utilization, capacity, validator weights) and an API explorer driven by Lium's published OpenAPI spec.
backend: lium-rs (Rust: axum, MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP + stdio)

byok.note: every call is billed to the caller's own Lium credits; public reads need no key

app.serves: zero-dependency console: MARKET (browse and rent nodes), PODS (ssh, logs, reboot, stop), SUBNET (supply, utilization, validator weights), API explorer (endpoints, playground, call log), MCP (tool registry, tools/call, client config)
app.keys: held in the browser tab (sessionStorage) and sent as x-api-key; never stored or logged server-side

env.LIUM_API_KEY: default Lium API key when a request carries none
env.LIUM_BASE_URL: override the upstream base URL (default https://lium.io/api)
